newsitem.title: UK: Cookson down on debt, charge worries.
newsitem.headline: Cookson down on debt, charge worries.

text.p: Shares in specialist materials manufacturer Cookson Group Plc dropped over two percent on Thursday after the group released a first-half report.
Cookson shares traded five pence lower at 252p at 0800 GMT in a slightly firmer broader market despite news of a five percent rise in first-half pretax profits.
Traders said investors were disappointed at Cookson's capital outflow and debt figures and the news of a 25 million stg one-off charge for the second half.
"These are not spectacular figures and we think we're going to see a lot of downgrades," one dealer said.
An analyst at a leading London investment house said he was considering downgrading Cookson from "hold" but said no decision had yet been taken.
